title: Settle three Design v1.2 questions the way the tickets already lean?
bluf: The design review left three product calls. (1) Roles: write a Partner/Consultant/Admin/Demo definition and do NOT add a Customer role or in-session role switch. (2) Customer switching: keep the top-bar picker, Back link and Open buttons as drawn. (3) Good/Better/Best: no packages page; keep the recommendation tiers as groupings; hold the labels 'Revenue and proposals' and 'Customer engagements'. Option A accepts all three. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-390, HPSMPOC-391, HPSMPOC-392

options.label: Go through them one at a time
options.detail: Tuesday sends them back as three cards.

default_action: Option A recorded as the product owner's ruling in the tickets' next records pass.
